name: Veanessa Burbage

summary.text: Veanessa Burbage holds a bachelor's degree and has owned and operated a medical spa for more than 30 years. She said she has no connection to CU but admires the university.

experience.text: Owner and operator of a medical spa for more than 30 years.

education_focus.text: Burbage's top priority is affordability; she supports an audit of CU 'to ensure efficient use of all funds.'

She says she would support CU's president on building out 'Super Intelligence,' data, and drone centers, and would consult with students and officials on what is needed to succeed with the technology.
She says she supports 'first amendment (freedom of speech) for everyone' on campus.

endorsements.name: Colorado Conservative Warrior (a voter-guide group run by Amber Adames)
